conditions.name: Salt-Rimed
conditions.effect_rules: Level 1 (light): -1 to DEX checks involving fine manipulation; visible salt-crystal-band on hands and lips; faintly tide-bloom in Drowned Church presence. Level 2 (heavy): -1 to DEX checks AND -1 to CHA checks against non-Greywake NPCs (they read you as 'one of the salt'); cannot be removed by ordinary washing; Drowned Church faction stance shifts toward favorable by +1 if heavy-rimed witnessed in cathedral. Both levels: practicing water flows toward the rimed body if within 5 ft; minor narrative effect but witnessed by NPCs.
removal_methods: Drowned Church absolution rite (Faith:Umberlee >= 4 required to be offered)

conditions.name: Recognized by Not-Yet-Named
conditions.effect_rules: The Unnamed has noticed the bearer. While active: +1 Notice from The Unnamed per cast of any Imposed-school spell; -1 to Stealth in metaphysical perception domains (the bearer is faintly visible to anything that perceives through Authority-pressure); +1 to Insight checks involving naming, oath-keeping, or word-power; one canon-event opportunity per long rest where the World Director may surface a 'name proposal' (an NPC or environment offers a tentative name for the Unnamed-as-noticed-you; declining holds the condition; accepting may resolve it but commits a contradiction ledger entry).
removal_methods: canon-event resolution (one of the name-proposals accepted; contradiction ledger seeded)
deicide of The Unnamed (extreme; substrate_practicing_word re-exposes)
Imposed Unrecord spell targeting the perception-event that started recognition (DC 18)

conditions.name: Debt-Marked
conditions.effect_rules: The bearer carries an unresolved debt to a named creditor (faction or NPC). Debt meter floor for this character is the debt value or 2, whichever is greater. While active: -2 to Persuasion checks vs the creditor or their representatives; +1 to Insight checks specifically about the creditor's interests; Tide League and Bell Court NPCs can read the debt mark on sight (it appears as a faint stamp on the bearer's clothing, brass-tinted); creditor may dispatch a collector NPC if debt exceeds 6 or in-world time elapses without payment. Bearer may transfer debt via canon-event (with creditor consent) or pay it off (which removes the condition).
removal_methods: pay the debt in full (creditor receives commensurate value; state_diff commits)
creditor's death or dissolution (debt void; contradiction ledger 'unmade_event' kind seeded)
transfer to another bearer via consenting canon-event

conditions.name: Bell-Marked
conditions.effect_rules: The Bell Court has rung the bell against the bearer (formally or by accidental association during an off-hour strike). While active: -1 to all CHA checks vs Bell Court NPCs; +1 to checks involving witnesses (the bell-mark counts as a witness in legal proceedings, sometimes for the bearer, sometimes against); Bell Court visitor ledger entries about the bearer are treated as canonical_observation rather than rumor; the mark is visible to Bell-Magistrate Orro and his deputies. Three accumulated bell-marks in a campaign (path:law domain weight >= 3) escalates to permanent Bell-Marked status with attendant legal consequences.
removal_methods: Bell Court formal absolution (DC 15 Persuasion or canon-event resolving the underlying charge)
duration expiry (most bell-marks expire over n_scenes or until_long_rest)
Bell-Marked Charm attunement (slice item) provides partial mitigation: -1 to penalty severity while attuned
